verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a changelog note that Linear's MCP can manage employee access through Okta-managed identity. Linear verifies identity via Okta and applies existing permissions, and admins manage access centrally without per-user sign-in. This is first-party identity-provider integration, but it is scoped to MCP access, not documented as organization-wide SSO. missing for 10: workspace-wide SSO login documentation, any SAML support or configuration docs, enforcement/provisioning details, independent corroboration.
